decisions.reason: As a flagship service closely tied to the firm's core vessel-management capabilities and future move into offshore and renewable segments, it is likely to stay unless results clearly fall short of aspiration levels.

Because it extends an existing support activity with strong operational fit and limited additional resource needs, a large firm with some slack would usually keep it while monitoring whether demand reaches acceptable levels.

The portal is a flagship, customer-facing digital extension of the core offer, so management is likely to continue backing it despite uncertainty as long as performance is not clearly below aspirations.

The app is adjacent but less central than the flagship offerings, and if its uptake has remained uncertain, behavioral-theory logic suggests resources would be reallocated to stronger core and digital projects.
